main.description:
Transition a matter's lifecycle status. Enforces allowed transitions:
  intake          → conflictCheck / engaged / withdrawn
  conflictCheck   → engaged (requires conflictCheck.result IN {clear, disclosureRequired, waivable}) / withdrawn
  engaged         → filed / closed (settled) / archived
  filed           → hearing / judgment / withdrawn
  hearing         → trial / judgment / conciliated
  trial           → judgment
  judgment        → appeal / execution / closed
  appeal          → judgment / closed
  execution       → closed
Reverse transitions are rejected. Use closeMatter for the terminal close flow (which performs open-blocker checks + grant cascade revoke).

conflictCheckRef.description: Required when newStatus=engaged and previous status was conflictCheck
